title: Procedural sound-effect kit
what_it_does: Node script that synthesises sound effects in code (no samples, no API), deterministic per seed, and places them on exact frames over a music bed with a cue plan; kit mode checks every sound's metrics.
when_to_use: Whooshes and hits under cards and cuts, with no sound library.
why: Free, no samples, so no sample licences; adapted from anidoodle (Apache-2.0), so keep its NOTICE. Listen before shipping: synthesised effects can sound thin.
